personality: 5 Brutalist Mobile (Modified for Civic Tech: Nothing OS inspired)
personality_one_liner: A radically clean, function-first civic tool using stark monochrome contrast and a single red signal accent to cut through the noise.

spacing.rule: Generous intentional padding. Content is king. Empty halves of screens are layout bugs, use width 100% or space-between grids.

dont's: Do not use glassmorphism or blur effects. Use solid colors for sticky headers and bottom tabs to maintain the minimalist, flat aesthetic.

screens.name: Citizen Home
screens.purpose: Location-aware feed of nearby civic issues.

states.empty: Clean line-art empty state, 'No issues nearby', with stark black 'Report Issue' button.
states.error: Error message with a 1pt bordered 'Retry' button.

screens.layout: Filter tabs (Nearby, City, State, All) as stark text with 1.5pt bottom border for active state. Issue cards take 100% width, 1pt border, flat #F7F7F7 background, structured metadata. No shadows.

screens.name: Report Issue
screens.purpose: Guided, multi-field form to capture civic issue evidence at the scene.
screens.layout: Single column vertical stack. Large photo upload zone with dashed border. Strict input fields with label above input. Sticky black primary button at bottom.

screens.name: Issue Details
screens.purpose: Comprehensive view of a specific civic issue with system analysis and community actions.

states.loading: Skeleton of the image and metadata grid.

screens.layout: Hero image at the top with mandatory vertical gradient scrim (transparent to ≥70% surfaceInverse). Title and severity/status tags overlayed at the bottom of the image. Strict data grid for System Analysis. Upvote and simulated donation actions in a sticky bottom container.

screens.name: Government Dashboard
screens.purpose: High-level overview of civic metrics and priority issues for officials.
screens.layout: Grid of stark high-contrast metric cards (black bg, white text). List of top priority issues with red accents for 'Critical' severity.

hero_garbage.alt: Garbage truck and waste pile on the street

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the minimalist, Nothing-inspired civic tech direction. Rely entirely on structure, typography, and contrast, avoiding any shadows, gradients, or glassmorphism.
Banned Colors: Any shade of blue, purple, indigo, or navy. Use the provided stark monochrome base with the #E50000 red accent.
Components should have subtle 1pt borders (#E5E5E5) for definition instead of elevation/shadows.
For the interactive map, try to use a minimal or grayscale map tile style if the mapping library supports it.
On 'Issue Details', ensure the mandatory gradient scrim is implemented exactly as specified: transparent to at least 70% opacity over the hero image.
Use Phosphor icons consistently. Stick to regular or bold weight, keeping them uniform across the app.
Implement haptics on major actions like 'Upvote', 'Report Issue', and tab changes.
